Based on the symptom that `rvfi_mode` only ever gets assigned inside the valid/write‐back conditional in cv32e40s_rvfi.sv, it clearly needs an explicit reset assignment there. Because `rvfi_mode` is part of the RVFI interface, you’ll also need to update the package that defines it, and ensure the CSR machinery is driving a known‐good privilege mode after reset (so that when rvfi_mode eventually gets sampled it isn’t “X”), and finally verify the writeback stage is carrying the reset properly into the interface.  The four files most likely to need changes are:

```text
bhv/cv32e40s_rvfi.sv
bhv/cv32e40s_pkg.sv
rtl/cv32e40s_csr.sv
rtl/wb_stage.sv
```
